results.title: VHP leader Vinod Bansal condemns trolling of Faria Abdullah over temple visit: 'At least respect women...'
results.description: Faria Abdullah responded to the backlash through an emotional video shared on her social media. In the video that she posted on her Instagram, the actress broke down while describing her experience.

results.title: Emraan Hashmi Announces Gunmaaster G9 With Aditya Datt And Himesh Reshammiya
results.description: Emraan Hashmi, riding high on Awarapan 2, reunites with Aditya Datt and Himesh Reshammiya for Gunmaaster G9, a romance-action entertainer releasing November 27.

results.title: SC directs Karnataka to comply, waits a week to assess Cauvery water releases
results.description: The bench was hearing Tamil Nadu’s plea seeking implementation of the CWMA’s decision directing Karnataka to release water to the state
